notes: אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ בּוֹ is a verbless clause with a prepositional predicate: *in … is* on the בְּ, headed on the preposition (rule 49), *whom* on the written relative, and the resumptive suffix unrepresented (rule 22).
The ethical dative לְ of קַח־לְךָ is left with no English by the bare *Take thee*, so it is unrepresented while its suffix takes the pronoun (rules 18, 40).
